entries.0cf4cc286f091066: Companies facing human resource challenges, etc.
entries.0f48b86b52bec97b: The segment notes print net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 as ¥15,822,441 thousand for the HR-Related Business and ¥597,734 thousand for the Financial Business. The Management Policies, Business Environment and Issues to Address section describes the active job openings-to-applicants ratio of 1.20 times and the unemployment rate of 2.6% for September 2025, as well as the focus on utilizing latent labor.
entries.181e941760b22436: Fees for financial services for businesses and M&A, investment and brokerage services
entries.1a869aeefbdc4f6e: The business is centred on the consolidated subsidiary Mirail Co., Ltd., with Protex Co., Ltd., Palette Co., Ltd. and Oshieteru Co., Ltd. also carrying out the business.
entries.1af4d25487fd1ee4: The HR-Related Business accounts for most of net sales, while the Financial Business is a small part of the total. As the environment for the staffing industry, the active job openings-to-applicants ratio for September 2025 is stated as 1.20 times, and the unemployment rate as 2.6%. It expects labor shortages to become severe due to the declining birthrate, aging population and shrinking working-age population, and is focusing on utilizing latent labor such as senior citizens, women and global human resources, and on creating employment opportunities for persons with disabilities.
entries.1d62fcf12250cd5a: The business provides financing for businesses and conducts M&A, investment and brokerage. Financing for businesses is provided by Crayrish Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, which handles bill discounting and real estate-secured loans, and M&A, investment and brokerage are handled by the consolidated subsidiary CRG Investment Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥597 million.
entries.1dbd49e46dba5101: Net sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥16,420 million, down from ¥17,090 million in the previous fiscal year. In the segment notes, net sales to external customers were ¥15,822 million for the HR-Related Business and ¥597 million for the Financial Business.
entries.2b5f370b73890d8b: Fees for interpretation and translation and accommodation management services
entries.30b3dc53b41acdfc: It is characterized by a nationwide registered staff base and rapid, highly accurate matching using a core system independently developed by the group. It has strengths in call center dispatch, and through unit-type dispatch, in which supervisors and operators are assigned as a set, it contributes to the retention of dispatched staff and the efficiency of on-site operations. Another feature is that one group can cover a wide range of fields, including clerical work, manufacturing and logistics, sales and marketing, and engineering.

entries.68739c5c2dbe67b6: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥153 million, and the previous fiscal year recorded a net loss for the period of ¥369 million.
entries.71efcbf8c992c4af: It states its basic philosophy as “Let’s enjoy growth,” and aims to create a setting where each individual can work with a sense of purpose while enjoying growth, and to realize a society in which everyone can work with vitality. In the HR-Related Business, it plans to expand direct services to end-client companies through call center dispatch, strengthen the use of women, senior citizens and global human resources, improve the functions of its core system and use AI for matching, and streamline clerical work through RPA. As issues to address, it cites the recruitment and training of dispatched staff, the securing and development of talented personnel, and the expansion of its revenue base, and states that it will provide comprehensive support for solving labor shortages through recruitment support and outsourcing businesses such as BPO, leveraging the knowledge developed in its staffing and placement business, and through its IT Solutions Business.
entries.7c70c24245c212fd: Through its subsidiaries, it provides temporary staffing and placement, manufacturing contracting, and financial services for businesses, and earns fees from customers.

entries.8fe1b11bdea0d6e5: The business is centred on the consolidated subsidiary Mirail Co., Ltd., with Protex Co., Ltd., Palette Co., Ltd. and Oshieteru Co., Ltd. also carrying out the business. It provides mainly clerical staff dispatch for call centre operations, dispatch to manufacturing and logistics sites and contract manufacturing, personnel provision in sales and marketing, and engineer dispatch, as well as transition support for persons with disabilities, satellite office provision, and interpretation, translation and accommodation management. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥15,822 million.

entries.da7d73bf7e43b3cc: Its customers are centered on companies that need to secure personnel or outsource operations. In the Financial Business, customers also include businesses that need cash flow support and companies considering M&A or capital investment.

Its head office is in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo, and it is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of September 30, 2025, the consolidated number of employees was 510; there were five consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate.
